svg.title: Dandelion Crown — step 1: Choose long, flexible stems
svg.desc: Ask a grown-up to identify dandelions and approve a place to pick a few. Keep the long stems attached and set the flowers on a tray. Choose fresh stems that bend gently. Leave plenty of flowers growing for insects.
